partial_participation: Update only sampled active identities; globally renormalize importance; apply removal only to observed identities
rffl_removal: Normalize signed EMA values before comparing with the fixed registered-population threshold; permanently remove and renormalize survivors; no warm-up
token_mapping: Normalize continuous gradient-budget quotas over sampled eligible identities; no payment when the common reference is zero; no stake slash
selection_objective: Mean attacker allocation cost plus mean honest false-penalty rate over complete pilot cells, with the same empty-allocation convention as the pilot plan
tie_break: Lower CGSV beta; RFFL retains the declared literature parameters
undefined_state_policy: A nonpositive signed normalization mass leaves history unchanged, pays nothing and is counted; any such round makes the affected candidate comparison undefined rather than silently favorable
publication_gate: Publish the selected parameters, source bindings and complete pilot evidence before scoring evaluation updates
training_policy: Offline shadow scoring of the exact retained matrices; no model retraining, personalized downloads or changes to FedAvg
